title: [Snyk Code] Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Closed: remediated in apps/dashboard/server.js by adding Express rate limiting middleware on /api routes, disabling x-powered-by, tightening corpus path sanitization (strict corpus-name validation + rooted path checks), and hardening query parameter handling. Local Snyk Code re-scan on 2026-04-13 shows no remaining findings in apps/dashboard/server.js.
